title: lepisorus onoei

This plant is traditionally used in East Asian medicine for its purported health benefits. Lepisorus onoei is believed to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Lepisorus onoei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
